term.label: cytosolic_rRNA_28S_gene

definition.text: A gene which codes for 28S_rRNA, which functions as a component of the large subunit of the ribosome in eukaryotes.

comments: Added as per request by Antonia Lock GitHub issue #472 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/472). Adjusted heirarchy and names of rRNA_gene terms at the request of Steven Marygold GitHub Issue #513 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/513).
